title: Gaussian Shading: Provable Performance-Lossless Image Watermarking for Diffusion Models
limitations: Distributional quality theorem is not image-by-image equality. The paper's inference about performance-losslessness from low t-values is author interpretation; non-rejection is not an equivalence proof.
V2 means method and evaluation windows inspected; experiments were not reproduced. DOI was not independently verified and remains null.
